_doc: Grand Hotel rooms (CHECKLIST 5.1, MareHotelRooms.cpp). 32 rooms, numbered by floor (3rd floor up, 8 per floor). The first three are the visitable 3rd floor: 301 suite (tools/ue58/gen_suite.py), 302 standard and 303 luxury (tools/ue58/gen_hotel_rooms.py, placed by Content/Python/mare_hotel_rooms.py); the others repeat the same models and are kept by the housekeeping crew. kinds: nightly rate = hotel reference rate x rate_mult; the guest profile picks the kind it asks for. tasks: what a check-out leaves to do (minibar = restock what the guest took, paid at the supply cost). crew: hotel housekeeping, tasks per hour between 8:00 and 18:00, the visitable rooms only after 'visitable_after' (the player's morning). Rooms the player cleans by hand get 'polished' (better rating for the next guest). complaints: phoned in between 8:00 and 22:00, chance per occupied room per hour, at most 'max_open' open; 'minutes' to solve it before the guest takes it into the review (mood penalty); the phone sends the technician for 'cost'; in the visitable rooms the player solves it in person for free.
_spots: Visitable rooms in order (301 suite, 302 standard, 303 luxury): where each task's mess and E target sit (world cm [x, y, z, yaw]; the mess is dropped onto the surface traced below z) and where each complaint is solved in person ('fix', world cm). UMareStaysWorld.
